verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents public Cloud Agent and Browser APIs. The docs cover creating runs via `client.runs.create`, multi-run sessions, cursor-based event polling for observability, structured output, and launching cloud browsers to connect over CDP. The llms.txt probe confirms the docs cover these 'Cloud Agent and Browser APIs'. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
